title: Privileged Identity Management and just-in-time elevation

videos.script: Lesson nine gave roles away for good. From the moment of the assignment, the power is there, every hour, asleep or awake. {{standing}} For a reader, that is fine. For the owner of production, it is a gift to whoever steals a session. {{risk}} Privileged Identity Management changes one word. The assignment becomes eligible, not active. {{eligible}} Eligible means you may ask. You prove who you are, you say why, and maybe a colleague approves. {{ask}} Then the role is yours for a few hours. When they run out, it switches itself off. {{expire}} Every request is written down: who, which role, where, for how long, and why. {{audit}} You will write one such eligibility in Terraform, and watch the provider refuse a file that ends it two ways at once. {{tf}} What you will not see is the activation itself. That needs a real tenant, and this lesson says so where it happens. {{end}}
